verdict.rationale: Shopify's own pages say Tap to Pay turns a smartphone into a checkout. It takes contactless cards, smartwatches and digital wallets, and creates mobile checkouts 'with just a smartphone', which covers taking payment without a separate reader. Support is first-party marketing only, and the older community comments about EMV and Interac concern card readers rather than Tap to Pay, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documentation of supported phone models and regions, help-center setup docs for Tap to Pay.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: Turn your smartphone into a checkout for on-the-go selling with Tap to Pay.
Tap to Pay works with contactless credit and debit cards, smartwatches, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and digital wallets for fast and smooth checkouts.
Create powerful mobile checkouts with just a smartphone.
